subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 345 (PMBA-9). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), TRS (transition) and TR (transformation). From PRI-INFO: IST-F (isolated focus). From TRS: RE-ST (restructuralism). From TR: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From IST-F: SOC-RT-DT (social reality dictates). From RE-ST: STF (source transfer). From TH-CONT: CPS-P. From SOC-RT-DT: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From STF: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). From CPS-P: SG (source initiation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
